status: prefreeze candidate under D056 (bounded package by Claude); not frozen; requires Codex acceptance and Barry's decision before protected access
question: How well do issued ExoClock DRD ephemerides predict later independent TESS mid-times, and does a population calibration learned from the previous release improve the predictive distribution?
availability_basis: OSF public-node and exact-file logs: DRD public 2025-11-18 09:43:24 UTC (D043); first whole UTC day

cohort.primary: core: 156 planets, one DRD-catalogued planet per host (not physically single-planet), Tmag < 13.5, P <= 12 d, no origin TTV flag

forecasts.M0: issued DRD linear ephemeris; Gaussian with C2 reconstructed T0-P correlation (not an issued covariance)
forecasts.M2: M0 forecast variance x latent lognormal multiplier exp(s z), median 1
forecasts.M3: M0 forecast variance x b^2 x latent lognormal multiplier exp(s z)

covariance_tiers.C3_source_fit_mismatch: otherwise; flagged, retained, sensitivity without C3

forecasts.parameter_rule: release transfer: fit M1-M3 on DRC forecasts of core-eligible planets against t015v3a outcomes after DRC issue (2022-09-28 to 2024-01-03); no regularisation prior; all-SPOC training is a sensitivity

outcomes.rule: t015v3a: scripts/acceptance.py (single fail-closed contract): frozen t015v3 timing (2c39f0a); SPOC 120-s PDCSAP; identification ok; finite product shape-fit reduced chi2 <= 100; no integration flag; finite timing; Gaussian certification consistent with exact 95% quantiles, else a likelihood grid passing the I1 adapter support check
outcomes.evidence: conditional injection calibration carried from the frozen SPOC samples after deterministic integration thinning (D054/D056); shape gate evaluated on development products and injection ledgers (results/prefreeze/)
outcomes.products: SPOC 120-s PDCSAP only; no FFI fallback
outcomes.identification: BLS within the issued DRD period +/-0.5%, epoch blind, depth SNR >= 7, other DRD planets masked
outcomes.error_convention: t015v3_beta_chi: sigma = beta * sqrt(max(chi2_nu, 1)); no Tmag multiplier
outcomes.attempts: fixed DRD manifest instantiated before fitting; every event receives one terminal status (scripts/prefreeze_attempts.py); windows map to events by DRD cycle number; cycle-ambiguous and multiple-window cases retained
outcomes.failures: scoring conditional on accepted timings; recovery reported against all intended opportunities and separately against coverage-qualified ones; never imputed
outcomes.late_bias: replication mean z +0.069 [0.013, 0.125]; reported, not corrected
outcomes.likelihood_representation: calibration fits: Gaussian with sigma = 68% half-width for every accepted event; scoring: I1 adapter (Gaussian when gauss_ok, else the accepted likelihood grid)

scores.primary: planet-balanced IS95 divided by the common M0 predictive SD (forecast plus outcome error); M2 minus M0
scores.decision_interval: 95% percentile interval over B = 2000 joint host resamples spanning calibration and evaluation hosts, refitting M1-M3 on each draw's calibration weights and scoring the evaluation set with the same multiplicities; multiplicities and parameters stored per draw
scores.decision: improves if the interval is below zero, worsens if above, otherwise inconclusive
scores.conditional_product_interval: fixed-parameter host bootstrap of the frozen candidate forecasts, B = 10000; separately labelled conditional result, not the decision

amendments: any change after freeze is dated and justified in coordination/decisions.md; the frozen analysis is reported first and in full
time_boundary_qualification: Five events within ten minutes of unconverted numeric metadata boundaries are excluded conservatively (D056 §3); predictions are BJD_TDB, boundaries' scale and reference not qualified
boundary_exclusions: results/prefreeze/manifest_boundary_excluded.csv (5 events; conservative subset, not exhaustive eligibility)
secondary_diagnostics: leave-k-gain-hosts-out curve, k = 0..5, fixed parameters, hosts kept whole, ranked by host contribution to the planet-balanced mean (descriptive)
later-known TTV label diagnostic with dated source; cannot redefine the origin-defined cohort
